hash: FNV-1a-64 unsigned wrap, non-cryptographic; not authentication
schema_bytes: ASCII('atto.actor.state.schema.v2') || 00 || le32(actor byte length) || actor ASCII || repeat(le32(field byte length) || field ASCII || tag)
snapshot_bytes: ASCII('ATTOST02') || version=2 || le64(schema fingerprint) || le16(field count) || repeat(tag || value) || le64(FNV64(all preceding bytes))

int.value: signed i64 little endian two's complement

string.value: le32(length in bytes) || strict UTF-8 Unicode scalar sequence; preserve BOM, NUL and normalization distinctions

limits.decode: validate version, full schema, all tags and lengths, canonical boolean, strict UTF-8, exact trailing boundary and checksum before publishing values
limits.ownership: owned data copies; no shared mutable storage
limits.migration: no implicit v1/v2 reinterpretation; explicit authenticated migration required
